iteration_1.v7_reproduction: With the fixed port, V7 (pfloor=0, i.e. no new mechanism) reproduced the plan's own Appendix A table to 3-4 decimals on every primitive (cone 0.886/0.984/1.041/1.030/1.013 ramp 1.175; cylinder 1.138/1.055/1.208/1.331/1.082 ramp 1.262; sphere 1.035/1.081/1.111/1.146/1.182 ramp 1.142; torus 0.979/0.914/1.051/0.978/0.943 ramp 1.149; ellipsoid 1.105/1.497/1.310/0.983/1.291 ramp 1.523; sphere-cam-b 0.911/0.920/0.966/0.727/1.064 ramp 1.465), and the within-family p01 collapse the plan reported: torus 0.0507->0.0004mm (plan: 0.0674->0.0005), sphere-cam-b 0.0302->0.0000mm (plan: 0.0301->0.0000). This CONFIRMS the plan's own GATE VERDICT: FAIL — cylinder 2 columns still outside [0.85,1.18], ellipsoid and sphere-cam-b regress out of the band, torus/sphere-cam-b p01 collapse toward zero (rulings touching).
iteration_1.new_attempt: Added a probe-based local plot-safety floor: after computing this ruling's curvature-bounded warp update, probe the candidate NEXT ruling it would place and measure its actual clearance to THIS ruling's own (already-fixed) points via the exact acrossClear() construction contFieldAniso already uses; if under a floor (0.5x want), damp the whole delta toward zero (i.e. toward the previous ruling's own accumulated field) in up to 4 iterations.
iteration_1.result: WORSE across the board, not better. Cone: ramp 1.175 -> 3.076, windows (measurability) 79 -> 12 — a measurability collapse. Cylinder/sphere/ellipsoid all degraded similarly. The mechanism is unstable: damping THIS ruling's own warp contribution without re-deriving how `f` accumulates forward creates a feedback loop across the family (a damped ruling still advances `f` by the same `df`, so the warp field and the parameter position decouple, and the next ruling's own floor check compounds the error). REJECTED BY MEASUREMENT within iteration 1.

iteration_2.what: Abandoned the custom floor mechanism (pfloor=0, i.e. disabled). Retuned only the plan's own existing V7 knobs: wsmooth 2->6 and 2->10, rmax 2->1.3, lam 1->0.6 (in combination).
iteration_2.result: wsmooth=6/rmax=1.3: torus p01 0.0507->0.0007mm (needs >=0.0431), sphere-cam-b p01 ->0mm (needs >=0.0257) — STILL FAILS. Some ramps improved marginally (ellipsoid 1.523->1.165, cylinder 1.262->1.826 [worse]) but the core crossing defect (condition 1) never closed in either retune. wsmooth=10/rmax=1.3/lam=0.6: same story, torus p01 0.0034mm, sphere-cam-b p01 0mm — still fails.
iteration_2.conclusion: Confirms the plan's own §2.2 point 4 / §4.1 finding: amplitude and smoothing knobs bound HOW FAR a sample moves, not how the ruling BENDS relative to its actual neighbour. Closing condition 1 needs the 'fifth required change' (an explicit neighbour-clearance fixed point reading the previous ruling's own emitted field, per the plan's own words) — genuinely new machinery, not a parameter retune, and out of reach of a two-iteration bounded spike without a real risk of shipping an unstable placement (as iteration 1 demonstrated).
